The '''D'Asta private fleet''' was the largest privately owned fleet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was under the control of the [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]] and his [[D'Asta family|family]].

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], several [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruisers]] from this fleet were used by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Llon Banjeer]] to house [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] at the [[Battle of the Hast Shipyards]].

By the time of the [[Crimson Empire]], it was the largest private fleet of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]] used this fleet to [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|defeat]] the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] led by self-proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Xandel Carivus]].

==Composition==
*[[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]]
*[[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruisers]]
*[[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]]
*[[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptors]]
*[[D'Astan starfighter]]s
